description.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of Rail Safety Week. It also encourages the people of the United States to educate themselves and others on how to be safe around railroad tracks and grade crossings.

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Railroads, Pipelines, and Hazardous Materials.

bill.title: Expressing support for the designation of the week of September 15 through September 21, 2025, as "Rail Safety Week" in the United States, and supporting the goals and ideals of reducing highway-rail grade crossing-related incidents, fatalities, and injuries.

aiDescription.summary: This House resolution designates September 15–21, 2025, as "Rail Safety Week" and formally supports efforts to reduce highway‑rail grade crossing incidents, injuries, and fatalities. It urges people in the United States to join Rail Safety Week events and education campaigns to learn safe behavior at railroad tracks and grade crossings.

impact.summary: The resolution designates September 15–21, 2025 as Rail Safety Week and backs Operation Lifesaver and the U.S. Department of Transportation's safety outreach. It urges state DOTs, freight railroads, Amtrak, law enforcement, motorists and pedestrians to support education, enforcement and engineering to reduce grade‑crossing incidents.
